topics.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra
topics.why: It's OpenAI's newest flagship model, launched September 3rd in a wave of releases alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Fable 5.1 — the AI tools knowledge workers rely on just got upgraded again.

topics.title: OpenAI's IPO could hit $1 trillion
topics.why: OpenAI is reportedly prepping an IPO targeting a near-$1 trillion valuation in Q4 2026 — a sign the AI boom is about to hit public markets in a very big way.

topics.title: AI is now the #1 reason companies cut jobs
topics.why: AI has topped the list of cited reasons for layoffs for four straight months, with Salesforce alone shrinking its support team from 9,000 to 5,000 using AI agents — worth knowing if your role touches support.
